theses.subject: Real Estate
theses.thesis: Real Estate leads the cyclical cluster with broad, improving cohesion and low-HHI leadership, making it the most durable concentration if volatility remains elevated.
evidence: Flow sector Real Estate: stage confirmed, rs_pctile 0.94, cohesion_gate.cohering=true, stress_conditional=true, leadership HHI 0.014, breadth broad.
Opportunity analyst: highest RS among cohering, stress-conditional sectors with broad participation.
Structural analyst: leading the cross-group cluster with cohesion improving and the only cohering member.

falsifier.text: If VIX surges above 25 and Real Estate cohesion_gate.cohering becomes false while its rs_pctile drops below 0.75 within 10 trading days, the overweight thesis is falsified.

theses.subject: Health Care
theses.thesis: Health Care’s extreme RS (98.4th %ile) rests on near-zero cohesion and isolated alpha names, making the concentration fragile and vulnerable to mean-reversion.
evidence: Flow sector Health Care: cohesion 0.15, cohesion_gate.cohering=false, yet rs_pctile 0.984; leadership top concentrated in biotech (HHI 0.011, alpha-driven).
Opportunity analyst: fragile concentration reliant on isolated leaders.
Skeptic analyst: rally is narrow, concentrated in a few biotech names, unlikely to persist.
theses.dissent: A sudden VIX crush could trigger a broad rotation that indiscriminately lifts healthcare names, and the flow lens lacks the forward edge to time such a turn, potentially bailing out the sector’s narrow leadership.

falsifier.text: If Health Care cohesion rises above 0.3 and its leadership HHI drops below 0.008 with new names joining the rally on broad participation, the underweight thesis is invalidated.

theses.subject: Materials
theses.thesis: Materials’ elevated RS is driven by a DDuPont single-stock distortion (±187.6%, 20% share, high HHI) with narrow breadth and no genuine sector co-movement.
evidence: Flow sector Materials: leadership dominated by DuPont (ret_20d 1.876, share 0.20, HHI 0.051), breadth narrow; cohesion_gate.cohering=false.
Skeptic analyst: a single-name artifact, not a broad theme.
Structural analyst: top-pair correlation with Industrials is a mirage driven by DDuPont’s extreme return.
theses.dissent: If VIX crushes and fuels a broad cyclical rotation, Materials could be swept higher on the theme regardless of single-name distortions, and the flow detector’s forward IC is ~0, offering no timing edge.

falsifier.text: If DuPont’s return normalizes but Materials continues to rise with cohesion_gate.cohering=true and HHI below 0.03 on broad leadership, the single-name-distortion thesis is disproven.
